senses.definition: (of people or their actions) feeling or showing great desire to harm others; malevolent
(a) (of a tumour) growing uncontrollably, and likely to prove fatal: The growth is not malignant. (b) (of diseases) harmful to life.
Someone or something that is hairy is covered with hair. [?]
examples: The function of a mammal's hairy coat is to insulate the body.

senses.definition: If you describe a situation as hairy, you mean that it is exciting, worrying, and rather frightening; a very informal use.
examples: It got a little hairy when we drove him to the station with less than two minutes to spare.
